main_text.p: ἐτionis vacuitas, (seu nulla concoctio) ἀνπεῖα facilitas coquendi, δυσπεψία difficultas coquendi: τέταξαι ordinatus es, ἀτάξια confusio, (seu ordo nullus) εὐτάξια bonus ordo: πέπραξαι actus es, ἀπραξία, cessatio, (seu actio nulla) εὐπραξία felicitas in reb. gerendis, δυσπραξία infelicitas in reb. agendis. πεποίησαι factus es, ποίησις actio: ὤφθαι visus es, ὄψις visio: λέλεξαι dictus es, λέξις dictio. Ex iis duo retinent augmentum, ἀντιπέπονθα ab ἀντιπάσχω vicissim patior, ἀντιπεπόνθησις reciprocatio: πείθω suadeo, πέποιθα fido, πεποίθησις confidentia, persuasio. Quaedam á secunda persona sunt in ια & ις, ut ab ἰγνάινω attenuo, ἰγνασία (sine ν) & ἰγναισις attenuatio: sic ὑγραίνω humecto, ὑγρασία & ὑγρασις humectatio: ξηραίνω sicco, ξηρασία & ξήρανσις siccitas, θερμαίνω calefacio, θερμασία &

page.notes: Greek text is rendered approximately; accents and letter forms in the Greek passages are uncertain and several words are marked only by inference. The first line "ἐtionis" appears to begin with a fragment of "concoctio" and may read "ἐκtionis" in the scan; the leading fragment is kept as a fragment. Printed number reads 285 (scan shows 285).
